title: Baselines: Orca's released policy on the same links
description: Orca's released policy (exp-orca-model-196, exported from Orca's repository at cafaf9a and checked against Orca's own code) as an agent_cubic agent with a 20 ms period: Linux 7.0's Cubic under it, each action rescaling Cubic's window, Orca's per-period statistics from TCP_CC_INFO. Same families, test links, conditions and campaign seed 31 as exp-baselines-192 and exp-baselines-pure-194; pairing is by link and condition. experiments/baselines_report.py reports it under the name orca.
prepare: (cd "$IN/orca/orca" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); P=(--policy "orca=$IN/orca/orca/orca.onnx@cubic:20"); S=; for fd in training:30 new:30 deep-long:30 cubic-first:60 rise:30 cellular:30 case-studies:80; do f=${fd%:*} d=${fd#*:}; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$f-$d" --split test --family "$f" --duration-ms "${d}000" --seed 31 --stock "$S" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$f-$d/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$f-$d"; done; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock "$S" "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; cp "$OUT/spec-training-30/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables flow_seconds; done
